title: Terminal diagnostic and historical-attestation evidence lost raw byte identities during Git transport

source_observation.environment: Hosted Windows verification of PR #80, run 31309327519, against MIR3TerminalExperimentReceiptV1
source_observation.fact: The durable archive copies of the two calibration plans and the governed 2.5.5 historical manual-review attestation were treated as text. Their stored or checked-out bytes differed from the exact source artifacts, so governance and manual-review custody checks correctly rejected their receipt hashes. The retained calibration worktree and the content-addressed attestation object reproduce the recorded SHA-256 identities exactly.

reproducer.expected: Archived diagnostic plans and raw-hash historical attestation evidence retain the exact source bytes named by their governed receipts across Git index, checkout, and hosted verification.
reproducer.observed: The received plan files did not match 0DF6A6BC2E20C01C6002DF78A8D84C4BBEDD5D765BA08CD246981DDA51466E0F and 18B42CD7FAF2D2D2A5B9B52A8451BF97B11148D780BB1E30E64C974FD6C89357 until restored from the retained calibration worktree; the attestation path did not match its custody hash 83AC0C36C02F2C41E1080706B0CD7EF2FE688956D38D79D579DE32F273944748 until restored from its content-addressed object.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; diagnostic and historical-review evidence byte preservation and Git transport only

target_dispositions.reason: modern release evidence must preserve archived diagnostic bytes
Factorio 2.0 assurance evidence must preserve archived diagnostic bytes

regression_obligations: the archived experiment receipt verifies both exact source plan SHA-256 identities
Git attributes prohibit text conversion for archived MIR3 terminal experiment JSON and the raw-hash historical 2.5.5 manual attestation
terminal governance fails if that byte-preservation rule is removed
the retained calibration worktree and durable archive copies are byte-identical
the historical 2.5.5 manual attestation and its content-addressed object are byte-identical
all .5 package archive and content identities remain unchanged
fixed_point_restart_scope: archived-diagnostic custody and assurance aggregate verification only; no package shadow restart

admission.reason: The failure is reproduced, bounded to immutable diagnostic artifact transport, and repairable without changing package source, product semantics, or published package bytes.

closure.evidence: PR #80 workflow 31309327519 failed closed at tooling.self-test because the experiment receipt hashes did not match transported artifacts. The retained calibration source files reproduce both receipt hashes, and the content-addressed historical attestation object reproduces its custody hash; c2a4494506bc465313b4bd3e95560a19df56c333 restores those exact bytes, marks each raw-hash evidence path as -text, and adds governance regressions requiring those rules. The CRLF-tolerant attribute validator at f2bfb9fce211f28dfbc70b5db37199721b785660 passed both exact-head MIR aggregates 31311037927 and 31311039681, then the fresh dev aggregate 31311371249 passed at merge commit d03b2a63bcd56cc446da5f5dc2fcf6e5fe286a6f.
